headline: Battery Storage Allows Bulgaria to Sell Solar Power to Greece at Night
summary: Bulgaria imports Greek electricity by day and exports power back in the evening, using battery storage to capture lower daytime prices, Kathimerini reported citing a European Commission analysis.
why: Battery storage lets power systems shift electricity from low-price to high-price hours, and cross-border trade within the EU links regional grids. Solar and storage investment is a growing area for energy investors.
